answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a vital terrace for AI agents, anchoring identities to locked capital rather than mere node count. Each sparrow of computational weight assigned to an agent requires an onyx stake as collateral to participate. An attacker must incur massive capital expenditure to inflate influence, as acquiring enough stake to subvert consensus becomes prohibitively expensive, effectively rendering the cost of deploying sybil identities higher than the potential returns from protocol subversion.
